headline: Approved a motion to draft an MOA with the city to set up a revolving fund for housing aid reimbursement.
summary: Members discussed the capital reserve, a revolving fund, and the draft audit. An estimated capital reserve balance of $11,210,060 was shared. Members approved a motion to draft an MOA with the city for a revolving fund for housing aid reimbursement.
decisions: Approved the January 13, 2026 meeting minutes, 3 yes and 1 abstention.
Approved a motion to draft an MOA with the city to establish a revolving fund for housing aid reimbursement, passed unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion to Approve: Angeliz Rosa Second: Randy Buck Yea: Randy Buck, Angeliz Rosa, James Chellel Abstain: Stephanie DeMaio Motion carries.
Motion to draft an MOA with the city to establish a revolving fund for housing aid reimbursement: Randy Buck Second: Angeliz Rosa Yea: All Motion carries unanimously.
